# Component composition

When creating, changing, or reviewing Primer React components and hooks, follow
[Compose components around explicit contracts](../../contributor-docs/style.md#compose-components-around-explicit-contracts).
The checklist applies across packages and does not prescribe a particular
styling or behavior library. Use package-specific instructions for integration
details and preserve established public contracts when refactoring.
